subject: School Committee Representation and Terms
overview: The subcommittee evaluated municipal comparables, superintendent input, and historical election data regarding School Committee term lengths, ward versus at-large seats, and the mayor's role as chair. Members agreed to draft follow-up survey questions and tabled items on public participation and listening sessions to their next meeting.

items.title: Review of Municipal Comparables
items.summary: The subcommittee examined data from comparable Massachusetts municipalities on school committee size, term lengths, and the mayor's role, debating the merits of two-, three-, and four-year terms as well as at-large versus ward-based seats.

items.title: Superintendent Interview Feedback
items.summary: Van der Kloot reported that Superintendent Marisa Edouard-Vincent strongly advocated for longer school committee terms to facilitate long-term planning and reduce continuous campaign disruptions.

items.title: School Committee Survey Responses
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed questionnaire responses from current and former school committee members regarding ward representation, committee size, and whether the mayor should serve as chair.

items.title: Historical Ward Representation Analysis
items.summary: Browne presented an analysis of election data from 2005 to 2023 detailing disparities in candidate residency across city wards, sparking debate over whether moving away from at-large elections would improve geographic equity.

items.title: Massachusetts Association of School Committees Inquiry
items.summary: Van der Kloot reported on feedback from the executive director of the Massachusetts Association of School Committees regarding ward-based representation and noted statewide listserv challenges.

items.title: Tabling of Agenda Items
items.summary: Approved a motion to table agenda items regarding community participation and school committee listening sessions to the next meeting.

items.title: Scheduling and Next Steps
items.summary: The subcommittee scheduled its next meeting for February 13, 2024, and agreed to draft concise follow-up survey questions and request an interview with the mayor.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: No members of the public requested to speak.
